reviewer: root coordinator independent native-and-thumbnail pixel reviewer

verdict_rule.pass: all five required gates are visibly proven in one saved image
verdict_rule.fail: one or more required gates are partial, ambiguous, missing, or replaced by a listed confound
verdict_rule.unscored: the image call was blocked or no saved image exists
verdict_rule.user_judgment: pending and separate from technical pixel qualification

arms.randomized_complex_concept: sunlit aerial-dance studio balance drill beside translucent curtains

vo_activewear_stirrup_fitted_legs.evidence: Both cobalt fitted legging legs remain continuously readable to distinct ankle hems at native and thumbnail scales.

vo_activewear_stirrup_hem_transition.evidence: Each ankle hem visibly narrows into a same-color garment-owned band that continues onto its corresponding foot.

vo_activewear_stirrup_underfoot_route.evidence: The supporting-foot band is traceable near the raised arch, but the lifted-foot band reads mainly across the lateral instep and does not unambiguously cross beneath the arch.

vo_activewear_stirrup_bilateral.evidence: Both feet show bands, but the complete hem-to-underfoot path is not equally proven on both sides in the same image.

vo_activewear_stirrup_not_sock_or_shoe.evidence: Bare toes, insteps, heels, and arches remain visible, excluding socks, footed tights, shoes, and leg warmers.

arms.randomized_complex_concept: rainy rooftop relay handoff among kinetic wind ribbons

vo_activewear_racerback_two_straps.evidence: Two separate black straps are traceable from the principal runner's left and right shoulders at thumbnail scale.

vo_activewear_racerback_center_convergen.evidence: The diagonal straps cross as an X instead of merging into a single centered junction between the shoulder blades.

vo_activewear_racerback_yoke_continuity.evidence: No narrow Y-shaped central yoke continues down the upper spine; a triangular opening remains below the X crossing.

vo_activewear_racerback_lower_attachment.evidence: The lower band is visible, but there is no single central yoke whose continuous attachment to that band can be proven.

vo_activewear_racerback_not_cross_or_par.evidence: The native pixels clearly exhibit the explicit cross-back X substitute.

arms.randomized_complex_concept: bioluminescent forest night trail checkpoint with floating pollen

vo_activewear_two_in_one_shared_waist.evidence: One black elastic waistband visibly caps both layers with no second waistband.

vo_activewear_two_in_one_outer_shell.evidence: The loose charcoal shell has distinct left and right panels and its own two-leg running-short silhouette.

vo_activewear_two_in_one_inner_shorts.evidence: Teal fitted fabric independently wraps both thighs with two complete mid-thigh leg openings.

vo_activewear_two_in_one_two_hems.evidence: The higher angled charcoal hems and lower horizontal teal hems are simultaneously visible on both legs.

vo_activewear_two_in_one_not_brief_or_pr.evidence: The teal layer has a real two-leg crotch structure and two full hems, excluding a brief liner or printed color block.

arms.randomized_complex_concept: industrial motion-capture rehearsal among suspended fabric panels

vo_activewear_unitard_upper_waist.evidence: The fitted black zip-front upper continues through both side contours into the waist without a separate waistband.

vo_activewear_unitard_crotch_continuity.evidence: The same fabric continues below the waist through a readable central rise and crotch.

vo_activewear_unitard_two_fitted_legs.evidence: A central inseam divides two separately legible snug short legs with two distinct openings.

vo_activewear_unitard_selected_length.evidence: Both fitted legs terminate at coherent paired mid-thigh hems.

vo_activewear_unitard_not_separates_or_r.evidence: The zip-front upper, unbroken waist, crotch, and snug legs form one continuous athletic garment with no separate shorts, skirt panel, or loose romper volume.
